An essay without a description, so the first paragraph with *emphasis*, `code` and a [link](https://example.com/) becomes the summary. It is deliberately long enough that the fallback has to be cut on a word boundary before it reaches one hundred and sixty characters.

## A heading

Text with ~~strikethrough~~, a bare autolink https://example.com/auto and a footnote.[^1]

| name | value |
|---|---|
| a | 1 |
| b | 2 |

```sh
echo "<b>not html</b> & more"
```

Raw HTML is not rendered: <script>alert(1)</script> and <b>bold</b>.

A [bad link](javascript:alert(1)) stays inert.

[^1]: The footnote text.
